brand.name: NhaChung
brand.tag: Live freely, work from anywhere, connect globally
badges.real: Learn real, work real, earn real
hero.kicker: Live freely, work from anywhere, connect globally
hero.h1: NhaChung is where people live real, work real, earn real, and build real community.
hero.lead: A global ecosystem for people who want to live freely, work from anywhere, collaborate through real value, and move from online coordination into real life.
hero.panel.title: 4 member layers
hero.panel.hint: Start public, then move through member, action, and expert layers.
hero.panel.l1.v: Public - understand the system, see the vision, join free.
hero.panel.l2.v: Free member - profile, dashboard, and foundational opportunities.
hero.panel.l3.v: Paid member - earning plans, teamwork, marketplace, and affiliate tools.
hero.panel.l4.v: Expert - projects, teams, point milestones, and long-term ecosystem access.
what.p1: NhaChung is a living, learning, working, investing, and community ecosystem. It is not an entertainment social network. It is not a get-rich-quick scheme. It connects people, work, and daily life inside a structure built on trust.
what.is.li1: An infrastructure for living freely and working from anywhere.
what.is.li2: A system for collaborating through real value.
what.is.li3: A bridge from online coordination into real life.
vision.p1: NhaChung is built for people who want remote work, cross-border collaboration, and communities that can grow from digital space into chapters, projects, and physical homes over the next 2-5 years.
vision.left.h3: Live freely, stay within the law
vision.left.li1: Choose where to live with flexibility.
vision.left.li2: Work from anywhere with clear standards.
vision.left.li3: Build income through real skills and real projects.
vision.left.li4: Move from individual to team, then from team to community.
vision.right.h3: Three value layers must move together
vision.right.note: The public website carries the vision. The internal app runs membership. The API protects truth in data, payments, points, affiliate logic, and audit trails.
system.p1: People move through a clear path: understand the system, create a profile, join programs, unlock earning opportunities, build points, and gradually move toward the expert layer.
system.step1.d: See the vision, understand the system, join free, and start onboarding.
system.step2.d: Complete the profile, receive guidance, join the community, and view opportunities.
system.step3.d: Unlock plans, payment, points, affiliate flows, projects, marketplace, and teamwork.
system.step4.d: Hit point milestones, pass review, and open projects, teams, chapters, and long-term pathways.
system.callout.title: The 3-layer technical contract must stay stable
system.callout.hint: The landing goes live first, but app and API contracts still need to be locked so later releases can integrate fast.
opportunities.p1: NhaChung does not stand alone. It opens bridges to related partners, programs, and ecosystems so members have clearer paths for learning, working, collaborating, and building income.
opportunities.card1.p: Living freely, working remotely, cross-border collaboration, and sustainable growth are core to NhaChung.
opportunities.card2.p: Open pathways into programs, ideas, and value touchpoints for members who want to learn, work, and build a real-life system.
opportunities.card3.p: Connect international collaboration paths, partner platforms, and long-term growth journeys for people moving toward global work.
levels.p1: Each layer opens a different level of responsibility, collaboration, and benefit. The goal is that everyone entering the system knows where they are and how to move forward.
levels.l1d: Understand the system, see the vision, read public materials, and join free.
levels.l2d: Get a basic profile, a simple dashboard, a light feed, and foundational opportunities.
levels.l3d: Unlock plans, teamwork, projects, affiliate tools, marketplace access, and income pathways.
levels.l4d: Advance through points, reviews, real projects, real teams, and a long-term ecosystem.
pricing.p1: The homepage only shows a teaser. Deep content, project rooms, and action tools unlock only when a person enters the right layer.
pricing.p0.title: Starter
pricing.p0.desc: Basic guidance and a simple starting path.
pricing.p1.title: Builder
pricing.p1.desc: Plans, materials, and a clearer action structure.
pricing.p2.title: Pro
pricing.p2.desc: Projects, teamwork, stronger collaboration tools, and a deeper earning layer.
pricing.p3.title: Master
pricing.p3.desc: Strategy, mentor support, and a closer path toward the expert layer.
pricing.callout.title: The goal of Layer 3
pricing.callout.hint: Designed to help members build toward a reference income range of around USD 1,000-2,000 per month, depending on skill, time, contribution, and market conditions.
roadmap.p1: The system does not wait for everything before launch. NhaChung goes in order: launch the landing first, then open the app shell, then gradually unlock membership, payment, points, affiliate, project, expert, and device layers.
faq.q1: How is NhaChung different from a normal online community?
faq.a1: NhaChung does not optimize for attention. It optimizes for real action, real collaboration, real value, and a pathway that can move from online into real life.
faq.a2: Yes. People can start with a free account to understand the system, create a profile, and see the journey. Deeper action layers require the right plan later.
faq.a3: No. The system is built to improve the chance of earning through skill, projects, and real collaboration. Results still depend on ability, time, contribution, and market conditions.
faq.q4: How is the expert layer unlocked?
faq.a4: The expert layer is not sold directly. Members move into it through points, review, verified profile status, and real contribution.
ctaBlock.p1: Register free to begin the member journey. Open the app to see the internal shell. Use Verify for proof checks and Admin for operating flows.
legal.note: The landing is for introduction and navigation. The internal app handles the member journey, payment, points, affiliate, project, and expert layers.
footer.muted: Live freely, work from anywhere, connect globally.
legal.privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy - NhaChung
legal.privacy.meta.description: NhaChung privacy policy for the live-first bilingual landing.
legal.privacy.subtitle: A live-first privacy baseline focused on minimum data, transparent operations, and controlled internal access.
legal.privacy.s1.p: NhaChung limits collection to the minimum data needed to operate accounts, verify profiles, manage access, and support internal proof records.
legal.privacy.s2.p: Data is used to run the platform, protect accounts, verify member state, support operating requests, and improve platform stability.
legal.privacy.s3.p: NhaChung applies limited access, separated admin roles, and the principle of reducing unnecessary data exposure outside approved operating flows.
legal.privacy.s4.p: Any request to review, adjust, or process data must go through the correct operating channel and the required verification steps before the system accepts it.
legal.terms.meta.title: Terms of Use - NhaChung
legal.terms.meta.description: NhaChung terms of use for the live-first bilingual landing.
legal.terms.subtitle: A live-first terms baseline for using the system in the intended, lawful, and role-appropriate way.
legal.terms.s1.p: NhaChung exists to present the vision, coordinate the member journey, and unlock the right tool layers for each level of access, responsibility, and contribution.
legal.terms.s2.p: Users are responsible for providing accurate information, protecting their own accounts, and using the platform lawfully and in ways that do not harm the community.
legal.terms.s3.p: NhaChung may review, limit, suspend, or adjust access when it detects operating risk, policy violations, or behavior that harms the system.
legal.terms.s4.p: NhaChung provides the infrastructure, process, and coordination layer. Learning results, collaboration outcomes, project success, and income depend on skill, effort, market conditions, and participating parties.
